items.title_zh: nemarDatasets/nm000343：面向被动BCI的开放多会话EEG认知数据集
items.title_en: nemarDatasets/nm000343: Open Multi-Session EEG Cognitive Dataset for Passive BCI
bullets_zh: Hinss等2021年提供面向被动BCI应用的开放EEG认知数据集。
它包含人类被试的多会话、多任务记录。
该仓库支持非侵入式EEG解码流程的基准测试。
bullets_en: Hinss et al. 2021 provides an open EEG cognitive dataset for passive BCI applications.
It includes multi-session and multi-task recordings from human participants.
The repository supports benchmarking non-invasive EEG decoding pipelines.
items.brief: Hinss 2021开放多会话EEG认知数据集，支持被动BCI评测。
items.brief_en: Hinss 2021 open multi-session EEG cognitive dataset supports passive BCI benchmarking and research.
items.raw_excerpt: Hinss et al. 2021 — Open multi-session and multi-task EEG cognitive Dataset for passive brain-computer Interface Applications

items.title_zh: nemarDatasets/nm000250：含用户画像的大型运动想象BCI研究EEG数据库
items.title_en: nemarDatasets/nm000250: Large EEG Database with User Profiles for Motor Imagery BCI Research
bullets_zh: Dreyer等2023年发布面向运动想象BCI研究的大型EEG数据库。
它加入用户画像信息，支持被试层面分析。
该数据集可用于评估MI-BCI算法与可复现性。
bullets_en: Dreyer et al. 2023 releases a large EEG database for motor imagery BCI research.
It adds users' profile information to support subject-level analysis.
The dataset is useful for evaluating MI-BCI algorithms and reproducibility.
items.brief: Dreyer 2023大型EEG数据库含用户画像，服务运动想象BCI研究。
items.brief_en: Dreyer 2023 large EEG database with user profiles supports motor imagery BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: Dreyer et al. 2023 — A large EEG database with users' profile information for motor imagery brain-computer interface research

items.title_en: PyBCI-release: Early-access Desktop EEG and BCI Workspace Downloads
bullets_zh: PyBCI-release提供桌面EEG与脑机接口工作区的早期访问下载。
它面向非侵入式EEG实验，并提供打包软件工具。
该发布可帮助用户搭建本地BCI开发环境。
bullets_en: PyBCI-release offers early-access downloads for a desktop EEG and BCI workspace.
It targets non-invasive EEG experimentation with packaged software tools.
The release can help users set up local BCI development environments.
items.brief: PyBCI桌面EEG/BCI工作区早期访问下载，便于非侵入式实验开发。

items.title_zh: AxonOS社区雷达：开放脑机接口领域的动态地图
items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar: Living Map of the Open BCI Field
bullets_zh: AxonOS社区雷达是自动更新的GitHub项目，用于映射开放BCI领域。
它汇总社区资源、工具与项目以便发现。
该雷达可帮助研究者跟踪非侵入式BCI生态活动。
bullets_en: AxonOS Community Radar is an auto-updated GitHub project mapping the open BCI field.
It aggregates community resources, tools, and projects for discovery.
The radar can help researchers track non-invasive BCI ecosystem activity.
items.brief: AxonOS社区雷达动态汇总开放BCI资源，便于发现项目与工具。
items.brief_en: AxonOS Community Radar dynamically maps open BCI resources to help discover projects and tools.
items.raw_excerpt: AxonOS Radar — a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field. An AxonOS community project.

items.title_zh: NeuroFlux BCI临床平台：EEG/EMG采集与试验管理
items.title_en: NeuroFlux BCI Clinical Platform: EEG/EMG Acquisition and Trial Management
bullets_zh: NeuroFlux是面向EEG/EMG采集与BCI数据处理的GitHub平台。
它包含数字滤波、频谱分析、ERP分段和试验管理功能。
该项目支持非侵入式临床试验流程，而非植入手术。
bullets_en: NeuroFlux is a GitHub platform for EEG/EMG acquisition and BCI data processing.
It includes digital filtering, spectral analysis, ERP epoching, and trial management features.
The project supports non-invasive clinical-trial workflows rather than implant surgery.
items.brief: NeuroFlux平台整合EEG/EMG采集与ERP分析，支持临床试验管理。
items.brief_en: NeuroFlux integrates EEG/EMG acquisition and ERP analysis for non-invasive BCI clinical trial management.
items.raw_excerpt: High-fidelity neuroscience and brain-computer interface data platform for multi-channel EEG/EMG biosignal acquisition, digital filtering, spectral analysis, ERP epoching, and clinical trial management.

items.title_en: BigP3BCI Study A P300 BCI EEG Dataset
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库nemarDatasets/nm000269托管BigP3BCI研究A数据集。
该数据集包含13名健康受试者的P300脑机接口EEG记录，关联Mainsah等2025年研究。
该更新支持非侵入式P300 BCI方法的基准测试与评估。
bullets_en: GitHub repository nemarDatasets/nm000269 hosts the BigP3BCI Study A dataset.
It contains P300 BCI EEG recordings from 13 healthy subjects, associated with Mainsah et al. 2025.
The update supports benchmarking and evaluation of non-invasive P300-based BCI methods.
items.brief: 发布13名健康受试者P300脑电数据集，可用于非侵入式BCI评测。

items.title_zh: Guttmann-Flury等2025运动想象多模态BCI数据集
items.title_en: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 Motor Imagery Multimodal BCI Dataset
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库nemarDatasets/nm000265托管Guttmann-Flury等2025运动想象数据集。
该数据集结合EEG、眼动追踪和高速视频，用于跨BCI范式的视觉活动分析。
该更新可用于多模态非侵入式BCI基准测试及伪迹/眼动研究。
bullets_en: GitHub repository nemarDatasets/nm000265 hosts the Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 motor imagery dataset.
It combines EEG, eye tracking and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms.
The update is useful for multimodal non-invasive BCI benchmarking and artifact/eye-movement studies.
items.brief: 发布结合EEG、眼动与高速视频的运动想象数据集，支持非侵入式BCI评测。
items.brief_en: Releases a motor imagery dataset combining EEG, eye tracking and video for non-invasive BCI evaluation.

items.title_zh: 基于SSVEP叠加实时画面控制小车的趣味项目
bullets_zh: Reddit r/BCI帖子介绍一个趣味项目，用SSVEP叠加实时视频画面控制小车。
它展示消费级非侵入式EEG脑机接口交互，而非植入式硬件。
该示例适合初学者探索基于SSVEP的控制应用。
bullets_en: A Reddit r/BCI post describes a fun project using SSVEP overlay on a live video feed to control a rover.
It demonstrates consumer-style non-invasive EEG BCI interaction rather than invasive hardware.
The example is accessible for beginners exploring SSVEP-based control applications.
items.brief: 展示用SSVEP叠加实时视频控制小车，适合非侵入式BCI入门实践。
items.brief_en: Shows an SSVEP overlay on a live feed to control a rover, suitable for beginner non-invasive BCI practice.
